title: Collective Experimental Data Index - catalog entry
description: Schema for a single database/dataset entry in the catalog. The catalog stores METADATA and LINKS only; it does not re-host source files.

id.description: Stable kebab-case slug, unique across the catalog.

description.description: 1-3 sentences: what's in it, approximate size/scope, how the data was generated.

domain.description: Primary discipline. Add cross-domain relevance via tags.

subdomain.description: Finer topical grouping (e.g. general-properties, crystallography, catalysis, batteries, photovoltaics, reactions, spectroscopy, bioactivity, quantum-chem, hte-synthesis, benchmark-ml, high-throughput-exp).

data_type.description: Whether the underlying data is measured (experimental), simulated (computational), or both.

access.description: open = free download; registration = free account required; restricted = paywall/subscription for full access.

license.description: License of the underlying data if known (e.g. CC-BY-4.0, CC0, MIT, Unknown).

doi.description: DOI of the dataset or its defining paper, without the https://doi.org/ prefix. Null if none confirmed.

homepage_url.description: Canonical landing page or repository record for the dataset.

repository.description: Where the data physically lives (e.g. Zenodo, Figshare, Materials Cloud, NIST, GitHub, self-hosted).

associated_paper.description: Short citation of the paper that introduced the dataset, if any.

source.description: How this entry entered the catalog.

added.description: ISO date the entry was added.

verified_via.description: URL where the entry's existence/metadata was confirmed.
